newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds push higher after Ciampi's comments.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds push higher after Ciampi's comments.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Italian bond futures recovered from a weaker start to hold to higher levels in late afternoon helped by Treasury minister Ciampi's comments on Italy's deficit and February CPI inflation. He said Italian inflation was currently running at 2.4 percent and gave revised 1996 deficit figures.
* Bonds:Nov06 +3bps at 104.60, yield 7.20pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 165bps.
* Lira:991.85/2.15 per mark vs 988 late Friday.
